dct_title_s: A New map of the West Indies for the History of the British Colonies
dct_alternative_sm: A New map of the West Indies for the History of the British Colonies
dct_description_sm: Uncolored map. Originally published in 2 sheets. Showing West India Islands, the Island of Hispaniola, or St. Domingo, Cuba, Jamaica, and Bahama Islands. Relief shown pictorially. Longitude West from London.
